While within 30 feet, the creator can cast that stored spell with no components, its effects originating from the darkenbeast — which then immediately dies in a flash of purple flame.

monsters.name: Taisus
monsters.conditionImmunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Restrained

traits.name: Arcane Immortality
traits.description: If the taisus dies, its body crumbles to dust and it gains a new body after 1d10 days (reviving with all its Hit Points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a location it designated at creation), unless a Wish spell is cast on its remains to prevent this.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the taisus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The taisus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Force damage plus 16 (3d10) Psychic damage. If the target has spell slots, it makes a DC 21 Constitution save; on a failure its highest-level unexpended spell slot is expended.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The taisus casts one of the following spells (save DC 21, Intelligence), requiring no Material components. At Will: Detect Magic, Fireball (level 5 version), Invisibility, Mage Hand. 2/Day Each: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance, Plane Shift, Scrying. 1/Day Each: Befuddlement, Disintegrate.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.description: The taisus casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger.

legendaryActions.name: Deadly Drain
legendaryActions.description: The taisus makes a Brain Drain attack. It can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: The taisus teleports itself or a willing creature within 10 feet up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Venger
monsters.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), Passive Perception 18

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If Venger dies, his body dissipates into crimson dust and he gains a new body in 1d10 days, reviving with all his Hit Points somewhere in one of his lairs.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If Venger fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Venger has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.description: While mounted, Venger and his mount have Advantage on Dexterity saves, and he can force an attack targeting his mount to target him instead (not while Incapacitated).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Venger makes three attacks, using Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast in any combination.

actions.name: Crimson Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Crimson Blast
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Venger casts one of the following spells (save DC 19, Charisma). At Will: Detect Magic, Invisibility, Mage Hand, Silent Image. 2/Day Each: Alter Self, Contact Other Plane, Create Undead, Dimension Door. 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Imprisonment.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.description: Venger casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger.

legendaryActions.name: Booming Censure
legendaryActions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 60 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

legendaryActions.name: Crimson Strike
legendaryActions.description: Venger makes one Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast attack.

legendaryActions.name: Magic-Binding Chains
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target is Restrained until the end of its next turn and can't take the Magic action. Failure or Success: Venger can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.
